summary.content:
Today's selection covers 87 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 16 articles published in the last 24 hours
